question: Which of the following states is the largest producer of jowar in India, as of 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharastra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharastra is the top producer of jowar in India.**
 
• **Jowar:**
 
 
• It is a crop that is mostly grown in moist areas and is rainfed; irrigation is rarely necessary.
 
• In terms of both production and area, it ranks as the** third-most significant food crop.**
 
• **Rainfall: 30-100 cm of moderate rain**.
 
• **Temperatures: high temperatures ranging from 20 to 32°C.**
 
• Vulnerability of Jowar: Both excessive moisture and prolonged drought are harmful.
 
• **Soil: Light soils with good drainage are ideal.**
 
• It is cultivated as the major food crop in semi-arid areas of central and south India.
 
• In north India, Jowar is mainly a** Kharif crop** whereas it is **sown as both Kharif and Rabi in the southern states.**
 
• **Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh are the top producers.**
 
• **India is the largest producer of jowar in the world.**
